path.description: Target file path relative to frontend/ (e.g., src/views/profile/components/UserCard.tsx)

scope.description: Whether this component lives in src/components/ (shared) or src/views/<name>/components/ (view)

description.description: What this component renders and where it appears (e.g., 'Card displaying a user preview in list results')

props.description: Component props as 'name: Type' strings (e.g., ['user: UserResponse', 'isLoading: boolean']). Include 'isLoading: boolean' only for components that render data fetched from the backend.

existingComponent.description: Path to an existing component that can be reused or extended, or null if building from scratch

composedOf.description: Names of other components in this manifest that this component contains. Used to determine build order (dependencies first).

artboards.description: Paper artboard references for extracting exact design tokens

artboardId.description: Paper artboard ID for the Desktop variant

nodeHint.description: Description of where to find this component in the artboard tree (e.g., 'the card inside the results grid')

artboardId.description: Paper artboard ID for the Tablet variant

status.description: The build status of this component
